organizerEmail.description: The organizer of the gift exchange. Overwritten with the authenticated caller before the request is handled.

hatId.description: The gift exchange the participant belongs to

email.description: The address the participant is recorded at, used to find them

emoji.description: The face to mark them with. Must be one of the faces the application offers, which the handler is what checks: a gateway model can bound the length but has no way to state the list.
